_comment: One category per semester. Subjects and exam channels both live inside it,
so Semester 6 becomes a second category and Semester 5 stays intact as an archive.
'syllabus' is posted and pinned inside the subject's own channel by !learn setup.
Write it however you like. Re-running setup edits the existing pinned message
'key' must stay stable once messages are captured against it.

subjects.name: Computer Networks
subjects.syllabus:
**COMPUTER NETWORKS**

**Unit 1 - Introduction & Physical Layer**
Network types, topologies, OSI model, TCP/IP model, transmission media, circuit vs packet switching

**Unit 2 - Data Link Layer**
Framing, error detection & correction (CRC, Hamming), flow control, sliding window, ARQ protocols, MAC, CSMA/CD, Ethernet

**Unit 3 - Network Layer**
IPv4/IPv6 addressing, subnetting, CIDR, NAT, routing algorithms (distance vector, link state), RIP, OSPF, BGP

**Unit 4 - Transport Layer**
TCP vs UDP, three-way handshake, flow control, congestion control (slow start, AIMD)

**Unit 5 - Application Layer & Security**
DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, SMTP, FTP, firewalls, TLS/SSL, VPN

subjects.name: Data Mining Techniques
subjects.syllabus:
**DATA MINING TECHNIQUES**

**Unit 1 - Introduction & Preprocessing**
KDD process, data types, data cleaning, missing values, normalization, discretization, outlier handling

**Unit 2 - Data Warehousing**
OLAP vs OLTP, star & snowflake schema, fact and dimension tables, data cube, roll-up/drill-down, ETL

**Unit 3 - Association Rule Mining**
Frequent itemsets, support & confidence, lift, Apriori algorithm, FP-Growth, FP-tree

**Unit 4 - Classification**
Decision trees (ID3, C4.5, CART), information gain, Gini index, entropy, Naive Bayes, rule-based classifiers

**Unit 5 - Clustering & Evaluation**
K-means, K-medoids, hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, outlier detection, confusion matrix, precision/recall/F1

subjects.name: Machine Learning
subjects.syllabus:
**MACHINE LEARNING**

**Unit 1 - Foundations**
Supervised vs unsupervised vs reinforcement learning, train/test split, cross validation, bias-variance tradeoff

**Unit 2 - Regression**
Linear regression, least squares, cost function, MSE, gradient descent, logistic regression, sigmoid

**Unit 3 - Classification**
SVM, hyperplanes, kernel trick, KNN, decision trees, ensembles (random forest, bagging, boosting, AdaBoost)

**Unit 4 - Unsupervised Learning**
Clustering, PCA, dimensionality reduction, LDA

**Unit 5 - Neural Networks**
Perceptron, activation functions, backpropagation, overfitting, regularization, dropout, intro to CNN/RNN

subjects.name: Occupational Health & Safety Management
subjects.syllabus:
**OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY MANAGEMENT**

**Unit 1 - Introduction**
Concepts of health, safety and welfare, importance of OHS, safety terminology

**Unit 2 - Hazard Identification & Risk Assessment**
Hazard types, HIRA, risk matrix, job safety analysis (JSA), hierarchy of controls

**Unit 3 - Legislation & Standards**
Factories Act, OSHA, ISO 45001, statutory compliance, duties of employer and employee

**Unit 4 - Occupational Hazards**
Physical, chemical, biological and ergonomic hazards, noise exposure, occupational diseases, fire safety, PPE

**Unit 5 - Safety Management Systems**
Safety policy, safety audits, permit-to-work, accident investigation, root cause analysis, safety culture

subjects.name: Python for Data Science
subjects.syllabus:
**PYTHON FOR DATA SCIENCE**

**Unit 1 - Python Fundamentals**
Data types, control flow, functions, list comprehensions, dictionaries, lambda, exception handling, file handling, OOP basics

**Unit 2 - NumPy**
ndarray, indexing & slicing, broadcasting, vectorized operations, linear algebra functions

**Unit 3 - Pandas**
Series and DataFrame, loc vs iloc, filtering, groupby, merge & join, pivot tables, handling missing data

**Unit 4 - Visualisation**
Matplotlib basics, subplots, Seaborn, histograms, scatter plots, box plots, heatmaps

**Unit 5 - Statistics & Modelling**
Descriptive statistics, distributions, correlation, hypothesis testing, p-values, intro to scikit-learn

subjects.name: Web Application Development
subjects.syllabus:
**WEB APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT**

**Unit 1 - Frontend Basics**
HTML5 semantics, CSS (box model, flexbox, grid), responsive design, JavaScript fundamentals, DOM manipulation

**Unit 2 - Modern Frontend**
ES6+, async/await, fetch API, component-based UI, React (components, props, state, hooks)

**Unit 3 - Backend**
Client-server model, HTTP methods, status codes, REST API design, Node.js/Express, middleware, routing

**Unit 4 - Databases**
SQL basics, CRUD, joins, schema design, NoSQL/MongoDB, ORMs

**Unit 5 - Security & Deployment**
Authentication vs authorization, sessions, cookies, JWT, password hashing, CORS, hosting and deployment
